title: 怎样结束会议，明确大家接下来做什么
topic: 怎样结束会议，明确大家接下来做什么

source.title: How to end a meeting well - Dropbox
source.section: Steps 1–3: Begin with the end in mind; end on time; clarify who does what and through what medium
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 依据 Dropbox 官方 End a meeting well 指南：预先定义会议结束时的成功状态，提前提醒结束时间，临近结束时确认行动负责人，并尽可能异步处理后续事项。
paragraphs: Don’t schedule a meeting without a clear idea of what success looks and feels like one minute after it ends. Be bold. Write “outcome” or “the end” at the top of your meeting agenda document to align participants right away. This visioning exercise is like driving a boat — you tend to wind up where you look. Know in advance if you want alignment, answers to questions, or to assign actions.

Ending a meeting on time is a great way to earn trust. As the meeting facilitator, honoring the end time you all agreed to shows that you respect participants’ time and attention. It also affirms participants can join future meetings you schedule without worrying whether it will end on time. The key here is to watch the clock — and know that many videoconferencing tools have built-in timers to remove the manual burden. When you’re ten minutes out, alert folks to this reality. Highlighted in our learnings as a lab for distributed work, a recent Economist Impact survey showed that shorter meeting blocks and more frequent breaks can improve focus, quality of work, and overall well-being. While distributed work may result in more screen time, ending meetings on time can provide more break opportunities to stay refreshed and productive.

A key reason for using a documented agenda in meetings is it makes wrapping up much easier. With a few minutes left, write down action items and owners — this helps to create clarity and drive results. But don’t stop there. If you’re able, note which items will need a meeting and which can be handled async — and default to async where possible.
translations: 没有对会议结束后一分钟成功是什么样子有清晰的概念，就不要安排会议。要大胆。在你的会议议程文档顶部写上“成果”或“结束”，以便立即让参与者达成一致。这个愿景练习就像驾驶船只——你往往会看向哪里就驶向哪里。提前确定你是想要达成一致、回答问题，还是分配任务。

准时结束会议是赢得信任的好方法。作为会议主持人，遵守你们共同商定的结束时间，表明你尊重参与者的时间和注意力。这也确认参与者可以参加你安排的未来会议，而不用担心是否会准时结束。这里的关键是看时间——要知道许多视频会议工具都有内置计时器，可以减轻手动负担。当距离结束还有十分钟时，提醒大家这一点。在我们作为分布式工作实验室的学习中，最近《经济学人》影响调查显示，较短的会议时段和更频繁的休息可以提高专注度、工作质量和整体幸福感。虽然分布式工作可能导致更多的屏幕时间，但准时结束会议可以提供更多的休息机会，让人保持精力充沛和高效。
在会议中使用书面议程的一个关键原因是它使结束会议变得容易得多。在剩下的几分钟内，写下行动项目和负责人——这有助于创造清晰度和推动成果。但不要就此停止。如果可能，记录哪些项目需要开会，哪些可以异步处理——并在可能的情况下默认使用异步方式。

Write “outcome” or “the end” at the top of your meeting agenda document to align participants right away. This visioning exercise is like driving a boat — you tend to wind up where you look. Know in advance if you want alignment, answers to questions, or to assign actions.

Ending a meeting on time is a great way to earn trust. As the meeting facilitator, honoring the end time you all agreed to shows that you respect participants’ time and attention. It also affirms participants can join future meetings you schedule without worrying whether it will end on time. The key here is to watch the clock — and know that many videoconferencing tools have built-in timers to remove the manual burden. When you’re ten minutes out, alert folks to this reality. Highlighted in our learnings as a lab for distributed work, a recent Economist Impact survey showed that shorter meeting blocks and more frequent breaks can improve focus, quality of work, and overall well-being. While distributed work may result in more screen time, ending meetings on time can provide more break opportunities to stay refreshed and productive.

A key reason for using a documented agenda in meetings is it makes wrapping up much easier. With a few minutes left, write down action items and owners — this helps to create clarity and drive results. But don’t stop there. Pretty much every calendar tool now offers a setting that reduces half-hour meetings to 25 minutes and hour-long meetings to 50 minutes. Show up as a hero and activate this setting. Either start the meeting late (for example, 2:05pm - 2:30pm) or end it early (for example, 2:00pm - 2:25pm).

notes.explain: 在会议议程顶部明确标注期望达成的成果，有助于所有参与者从一开始就明确会议目标
notes.example: The meeting outcome is to decide whether the pilot can expand after the missing data arrives.

notes.explain: 作为会议主持人，准时结束会议是对参与者时间和注意力的尊重，有助于建立信任
notes.example: The facilitator honored the end time and sent the recap after the meeting.

notes.explain: 原文转述一项 Economist Impact 调查的发现：较短会议时段和更频繁的休息可能改善专注、工作质量与整体状态；这里是来源报告的调查结果，不是对所有团队的保证。
notes.example: Our team uses shorter meeting blocks and breaks to protect time for focused work.

notes.explain: 在会议结束前记录明确的行动项目和负责人，有助于创建清晰度和推动结果
notes.example: Before ending, list the action items and owners in the shared agenda.

scenario.title: Close a rollout review with clear next steps
english: A rollout review has five minutes left. The team still lacks one data point, so it cannot decide whether to expand the pilot today.
Priya can complete the analysis by Thursday. The routine analysis can be shared asynchronously; the team does not need another meeting just to review it.
State the desired outcome, defer the decision until the data arrives, name the owner and due date, promise a written recap, and end on time.
chinese: 上线评审还剩五分钟。团队缺少一项数据，因此今天无法决定是否扩大试点。
Priya 可以在周四前完成分析。这项常规分析可以异步分享，团队不必只为查看分析再开一次会。
说明期望结果、暂缓决定直至数据到齐、写明负责人和期限、承诺发送书面总结，并按时结束。

firstAttempt.prompt: 会议还有五分钟结束，但关键数据尚未到齐，今天不能决定是否扩大试点。Priya 周四前补完分析，该分析可异步分享。请用英文暂缓决定、明确负责人/期限、承诺书面总结并按时收尾。
firstAttempt.sample: We’ll hold the decision until we have the missing data. Priya owns the analysis and will share it by Thursday, asynchronously. I’ll send a written recap with the decision status, owner, and due date this afternoon. Let’s wrap up on time.
firstAttempt.rationale: 缺少数据就暂缓决定，写明分析负责人、期限和异步方式，承诺记录，并明确现在结束会议。

words.example: The facilitator confirms the decision and checks each action owner before closing.
words.translation: 主持人在结束前确认决定，并核对每项行动的负责人。
words.note: 指引导会议进程、确保会议目标达成的人，通常不是会议主持人

words.example: Our company has adapted to distributed work with flexible hours.
words.translation: 我们公司已经适应了分布式工作模式，实行弹性工作时间。
words.note: 分布式工作：团队成员在不同地点远程协作。

words.example: We prefer async communication for non-urgent matters to respect everyone's focus time.
words.translation: 对于非紧急事务，我们倾向于使用异步沟通，以尊重每个人的专注时间。
words.note: asynchronous 的非正式写法，常用于技术团队沟通。

words.example: Before we wrap up, let’s confirm the decision and due dates.
words.translation: 结束前，我们确认一下决定和截止时间。
words.note: 指会议结束前的总结和收尾工作

words.example: The team conducted a visioning exercise to clarify their long-term goals.
words.translation: 团队进行了一次愿景练习，以明确他们的长期目标。
words.note: 引导团队讨论未来目标或理想状态的活动。

words.example: We use videoconferencing tools to connect with remote team members.
words.translation: 我们使用视频会议工具与远程团队成员保持联系。
words.note: 通过视频会议软件进行远程会议。

structure.original: Don’t schedule a meeting without a clear idea of what success looks and feels like one minute after it ends.
analysis: "Don't schedule a meeting" 是祈使句的否定形式，作为主句，直接发出指令
"without a clear idea of what success looks and feels like" 是介词短语作状语，其中"what success looks and feels like"是名词性从句，作介词"of"的宾语
"one minute after it ends" 是时间状语，修饰"looks and feels like"，表示成功状态的具体时间点
structure.transfer: Before we close, let’s read back the decision and confirm the owner and due date for each follow-up.

rewrite.bad: We can finish the market research later. I need to leave now.
rewrite.good: We’ll hold the decision until we have the missing data. Priya owns the analysis and will share it by Thursday, asynchronously. I’ll send a written recap with the decision status, owner, and due date this afternoon. Let’s wrap up on time.
rewrite.translation: 在拿到缺失数据前，我们暂缓决定。Priya 负责分析，并会在周四前异步分享结果。我今天下午会发送书面总结，写明决定状态、负责人和截止时间。我们按时结束。
rewrite.pattern: We’ll hold the decision until [information is ready]. [Owner] will share [work] by [date], [async/sync]. I’ll send a recap with [status, owner, and due date]. Let’s wrap up on time.

cloze.prompt: We’ll hold the decision until we have the missing ___.
cloze.why: until 后面说明作决定前需要满足的条件。

cloze.prompt: Priya owns the analysis and will share it by ___.
cloze.why: owns the analysis 明确责任人，by Thursday 写明期限。

cloze.prompt: I’ll send a written recap with the decision status, owner, and due date this ___.
cloze.why: recap 汇总会后状态、负责人和期限。

dictation.text: Don’t schedule a meeting without a clear idea of what success looks and feels like one minute after it ends.
If you’re able, note which items will need a meeting and which can be handled async — and default to async where possible.

translationPractice.prompt: 在拿到缺失数据前，我们暂缓决定。
translationPractice.answer: We’ll hold the decision until we have the missing data.
translationPractice.why: hold the decision until 说明决定暂缓到哪个条件满足。

translationPractice.prompt: Priya 负责分析，并会在周四前异步分享结果。
translationPractice.answer: Priya owns the analysis and will share it by Thursday, asynchronously.
translationPractice.why: owns the analysis 标明负责人；by Thursday 给期限；asynchronously 说明后续媒介。

translationPractice.prompt: 我今天下午会发送书面总结，写明决定状态、负责人和截止时间。
translationPractice.answer: I’ll send a written recap with the decision status, owner, and due date this afternoon.
translationPractice.why: written recap 指定书面总结，并列出总结应包括的三项信息。

choice.prompt: 会议还剩五分钟，缺少关键数据，Priya 周四前能补完分析且无需再开会。哪种收尾信息最完整？
options: We’ll decide today. Priya can send the data when it is ready.

We’ll hold the decision until we have the missing data. Priya owns the analysis and will share it by Thursday, asynchronously. I’ll send a written recap with the decision status, owner, and due date this afternoon. Let’s wrap up on time.
Let’s schedule another meeting to talk about the missing data.
choice.why: 准确项保留暂缓条件、负责人、期限、异步媒介、书面总结和按时结束。

output.prompt: 客户试点复盘还剩五分钟，团队还没收到使用数据，今天不能决定是否扩大试点。Noah 周三前整理数据，团队可以异步查看；请用英文写明暂缓决定、负责人、期限和媒介，承诺写入共享议程并按时结束。
output.sample: We’ll hold the decision until we have the usage data. Noah will compile it by Wednesday, and the team can review it asynchronously. I’ll add the decision status, owner, and due date to the shared agenda. Let’s wrap up on time.
check: 是否把决定暂缓到数据到齐？
是否写出 Noah、周三和异步查看？
是否承诺更新共享议程并按时结束？
